mapper.sql: m.id, m.title, m.artist, m.album_name, m.image_url, m.genre, m.bpm, m.duration_ms, m.music_energy_level, m.source_type, m.spotify_track_id, m.spotify_uri, m.spotify_external_url, m.created_at, m.updated_at

where.if: AND MATCH(m.title, m.artist) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM music m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT music_id, AVG(running_fit_score) AS avg_running_fit_score FROM music_reviews GROUP BY music_id ) review_stats ON review_stats.music_id = m.id
ORDER BY m.title ASC, m.id ASC
ORDER BY m.bpm IS NULL, m.bpm ASC, m.id ASC
ORDER BY m.bpm IS NULL, m.bpm DESC, m.id DESC
ORDER BY review_stats.avg_running_fit_score IS NULL, review_stats.avg_running_fit_score DESC, m.id DESC
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id AS musicId, COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN r.member_id = #{memberId} THEN r.preference_score ELSE NULL END), AVG(r.preference_score), 3.0 ) AS preferenceScore FROM music m LEFT JOIN music_reviews r ON r.music_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id
